about: Spectacular deaths are rewards (docs/design/ARPG_FUN.md P1 item 5), read by logic/Sim/DeathShow.cs. An eligible kill (a crit, a blow of minBlow times what it had left, or an elite; never a boss) is shown at most share of the time, at most maxPerWindow shows each window seconds. A shown kill is a Burst (blow of burstBlow or a crit of burstCritBlow, not fire) or else a Launch (thrown along the blow; launchBase + launchPerBlow * min(blow, launchBlowCap) metres, clamped to launchMin..launchMax).
